title: Wet-edge detector on CTRL: count map-edge surface tiles carrying water and those at depth 4 or more, and the live feature entries; expected dormant.
fork: v5.8 wet-edge detection at load: a layer is live only when a deep wet edge exists and feature entries have stock.

arms.name: edge
pre: local me=df.global.plotinfo.map_edge; local wet,tot,deep=0,0,0; for i=0,#me.surface_x-1 do local x,y,z=me.surface_x[i],me.surface_y[i],me.surface_z[i]; tot=tot+1; local d=dfhack.maps.getTileFlags(x,y,z); if d and d.flow_size>0 and not d.liquid_type then wet=wet+1; if d.flow_size>=4 then deep=deep+1 end end end; local fe=0; for _,p in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do if p.type==df.world_population_type.Animal and p.population.feature_idx>=0 and p.quantity>0 then fe=fe+1 end end; print(('e25 edge: %d edge tiles, %d wet, %d deep (>=4/7); %d live feature entries -> %s'):format(tot,wet,deep,fe, (deep>0 and fe>0) and 'LIVE' or (fe>0 and 'DORMANT: no deep wet edge' or 'DORMANT: no feature entries')))
